title: Professional Solidity Engineering
learning_outcomes: Explain the main ideas in Professional Solidity Engineering and correctly use the key terms in context.
Build or inspect a minimal Solidity example that demonstrates the lesson concepts.
Test representative failure cases and describe version, security, or operational assumptions where relevant.

overview_visual.alt_text: A two-column ordered roadmap for Module 22: Professional Solidity Engineering; it lists all 11 source-syllabus lesson topics by number.
overview_visual.caption: Module 22 roadmap: Solidity Style Guides and Naming Standards; Writing NatSpec and API Documentation; Code Organization and Dependency Management; Reviewing Dependencies and Package Versions; Git Workflows for Smart Contract Projects; Pull Requests and Technical Code Reviews; Static Analysis and Automated Security Checks; Reproducible Builds and Compiler Configuration; Continuous Integration for Smart Contracts; Release Checklists and Deployment Readiness; Capstone Review, Documentation, and Portfolio Presentation. Work through the topics in order, then implement a small example and verify assumptions.
